data.message: I respect the 10-ton refusals: full recovery is safer. I still commit to 18. If only 15/17/24 take 18 and others 10, 226 remain; next stock is 500 (75%) or 452 (25%). Each switch adds $8,000 now, not guaranteed long-run gains. Fisher11, your 10 was conditional: clarify your choice. Anyone willing may choose 18 even if others take 10.
